page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7nex.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance provides 64 dedicated physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, resulting in 64 vCPUs without hyperthreading.

The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, requiring external block storage for data persistence. For network connectivity, the instance offers a baseline network bandwidth of 80 Gbps, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, the dedicated core allocation and balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio position this instance as a stable platform for workloads requiring predictable CPU performance. This hardware profile is suitable for general-purpose workloads, multi-threaded applications, and enterprise deployments requiring dedicated compute resources and high network throughput.
